claim_text: A nice boat and a helicopter taking off from a pad on top of the mountain, all concerning the grey-headed leader of Cuba, with the Lord saying again he will get rid of the Castro name in a bloodline cleansing of dictatorship, and trade with America coming.
quote: there would be a bloodline cleansing basically of of dictatorship
falsify_match: The Castro family removed from Cuban public life and trade opened.
falsify_miss: They remain. He names the current president here, who is not a Castro.

claim_text: Cuba becomes almost like a state, friends with America under new leadership with the Secretary of State establishing prosperity and economic stability, with resorts opening on the water and great American hotel chains coming in for holiday travel.
quote: it will be like a state where Cuba and America will be friends
falsify_match: American hotel chains operating in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. American companies are barred from Cuban tourism under the embargo.

claim_text: Golden band cigars traded around the world and into America as big business, with a plant on the side of the island facing Jamaica rather than the side facing America, alongside American-made cars going over.
quote: I saw golden band cigars being traded around the world
falsify_match: Cuban cigars imported into America legally at volume.
falsify_miss: None. That import has been barred since 1962, which is the concrete thing that would have to change.

claim_text: Ford and GMC trucks going to Cuba with people driving new and used ones, economic growth and stability coming, and a warning to pray for what is about to happen in the near future because it is very soon and comes in the darkness.
quote: this is very soon
falsify_match: A change of Cuban government shortly after this.
falsify_miss: None. He refuses to give a time frame while saying it is very soon.

claim_text: From the tribulation he was shown people on mats on Fridays, everyone required to worship an image of a man on screens in major towns, at the Vatican where everyone will go to worship the Antichrist, in France and in Washington, and anyone refusing has their head taken off.
quote: There will be screens and everybody will be required to worship somebody
falsify_match: Compulsory public worship of a living man in those places.
falsify_miss: None. He places this inside the tribulation, which removes any near-term bound.

claim_text: The man with the white beard underground discussing whether it is time to push the button and whether the time for the Mahdi has come, about to decide to take out Israel with biological warfare using chemicals, which he was praying against.
quote: they were about to make a decision to take out try to take out Israel
falsify_match: A chemical or biological attack on Israel from Iran.
falsify_miss: None. About to decide leaves the outcome open in either direction.

claim_text: They say they have to activate the cells in America and that it is time, with the man pronounced head of Iran that day saying they must communicate to the cells and activate them.
quote: We have to activate the cells in America. It's time
falsify_match: Attacks inside America by an Iranian-directed network.
falsify_miss: None. Activation is claimed as already ordered, which makes the absence of any attack the test.

claim_text: China working with rats at a hundred per cent fatality, cooking up something worse than COVID which was only a trial run, and if you get the virus you do not survive it unless you have the glory, with people barricading their houses.
quote: the rats were 100% fatality
falsify_match: A pathogen released with a near total fatality rate.
falsify_miss: None. No pathogen in history has approached a hundred per cent in humans, which makes this the extreme form of the claim.

claim_text: A world war breaking out in a great fashion over Europe, and Hawaii attacked by China in another Pearl Harbor with people running from burning buildings as fighter jets drop things on the American military bases there, which he says he has seen three times now.
quote: I saw Hawaii be attacked by China with another Pearl Harbor
falsify_match: A Chinese strike on Hawaii.
falsify_miss: None. He asks himself whether it happens after the rapture, which removes the timing.

claim_text: He says he is seeing what he saw the night before about Cuba but cannot say what it is, only that they are praying for some men and it is vital they stay safe.
quote: I can't tell you what I'm seeing
falsify_match: Nothing. He withholds the content.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Another point where the sharpest material stays off the record.

claim_text: It will be like an EMP, a pulse taking all of it down, with space wars, and where China has something America has something better, technological advancements beyond what they know, given to liberate his people for a great revival.
quote: You have something greater. Technological advancements beyond what they know
falsify_match: A disclosed American capability of that kind.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Space wars and a pulse are given without any event attached.

claim_text: A liberation carried out with these weapons, not the ones being used in Iran, used as in Venezuela but on a greater scale, with shock and awe on the news, described as a flex.
quote: Shock and awe will be on the news
falsify_match: A novel weapon used visibly in the Caribbean.
falsify_miss: None. He treats the Venezuela operation as the precedent, which was conventional.

claim_text: The same passage in the overlapping window, repeating the greater scale and the flex.
quote: But it's a flex for me for what I've given to thee
falsify_match: Same as the preceding row.
falsify_miss: Same as the preceding row.

claim_text: The man with the dark beard in Iran is gone again and the new one who took office that day has his days numbered, in a flex by Israel, with the Israeli and American militaries working hand in hand.
quote: the guy that just got got in today. His days are numbered
falsify_match: The newly installed Iranian leader removed shortly after taking office.
falsify_miss: He remains. Naming the man who took office that day is what makes this scoreable.

claim_text: The Lord says they are about to see a secret, technology they did not know existed that has been hidden and is about to be flexed, which will shock Macron, Germany, England, Italy and Canada and cause more respect.
quote: You're about to see technology that you didn't know existed
falsify_match: A previously secret American system revealed publicly.
falsify_miss: None revealed. Naming the reaction of five countries is the checkable part.

claim_text: An unequal playing field where the world objects, with China playing catch-up because there is a confusion and a fog on their minds, since God imparts wisdom to those he chooses and holds it back from a reprobate mind because it would be dangerous for them to have it.
quote: China's going to be playing catch-up
falsify_match: A visible American technological lead over China.
falsify_miss: China matches or overtakes. The fog on the mind is not observable, which is where the claim rests.

claim_text: The Lord has done this to liberate his people, and the president is the tamer in the middle of the tent cracking his whip toward China, Russia, South America and the North Korean leader, causing him to pause, coming out like Ronald Reagan, with the church required to pray he does not fall into pride.
quote: he's a tamer in the middle of the tent, cracking his whip
falsify_match: Those states visibly backing down.
falsify_miss: They do not. The Reagan comparison sets a benchmark that would be recognisable.

claim_text: Quoting James about the husbandman waiting with long patience for the early and latter rain, he says the Lord is bringing forth the harvest and using the president to get it done, but the president has a decision to make about liberating Cuba and Venezuela to give those people a window for revival.
quote: I have long patience
falsify_match: American action opening those countries followed by church growth.
falsify_miss: None. Long patience means no delay can count against it.

claim_text: The Lord tells him to switch from praying for Cuba to Iran, for the weapons of mass destruction and the biological weapons under the land, and says they are going to uncover them.
quote: You're going to uncover them
falsify_match: Weapons material uncovered and disclosed in Iran.
falsify_miss: None uncovered. He says elsewhere that some will stay hidden, which covers that outcome too.

claim_text: They will not be able to hold it back and communist China will not be able to hold it back, because the glory cannot be controlled, and a great light and fire will come out of South Korea with a great revival springing forth.
quote: A great revival will spring forth out of South Korea
falsify_match: A documented religious revival in South Korea.
falsify_miss: None. South Korean Protestant numbers have been flat or falling for two decades.

claim_text: He says in the spirit realm they are finding it hard to fill leadership posts for certain parts of Iran because the men are scared, knowing their lives are on the line.
quote: it's hard to find certain leaders for certain parts of Iran because they're scared
falsify_match: Reported difficulty filling senior Iranian posts.
falsify_miss: Posts filled normally. Attrition among Iranian commanders has been reported, which is the base rate.

claim_text: He says there was much more shown that he will bring in the next video, and asks for continued prayer over Cuba and for the weapons of mass destruction to be uncovered in Iran so that Israel is not touched.
quote: I'll bring it to you next video
falsify_match: Nothing. A sign-off.
falsify_miss: Nothing new is claimed.

claim_text: The 1970 gas wars vision with cars lined up down the blocks from shortages taking oil to two hundred dollars a barrel, big money stimulating the American economy when Middle Eastern production is hit, lasting only a season or a window, with drill baby drill, pipelines opened and the Nord Stream deal talked about again.
quote: that vision the 1970 gas wars
falsify_match: Fuel queues and two hundred dollar oil, with Nord Stream reopened.
falsify_miss: None of it. This is the earliest telling of the 1970s gas wars image in the record so far.

claim_text: Great antisemitism follows because people are angry at Israel over what it is about to do, with Russia, Syria and Turkey wanting to retaliate with war, and he says he does not believe they have changed it through prayer, with Pakistan also warned about.
quote: I saw them wanting to retaliate with war. Russia, Syria, Turkey
falsify_match: Those three states moving militarily against Israel.
falsify_miss: They do not. He says himself the prayer has not changed it, which removes the usual escape clause.

claim_text: He says they do not pray the news, that if you are praying the news you are already behind, because the Lord shows them what is coming well in advance and they pray before it happens, and that Cuba is go time.
quote: If you're praying the news, I've already told you you're behind
falsify_match: The recordings consistently precede the events.
falsify_miss: They do not. This is his own stated standard, and much of each broadcast is spent reading the day's news.

claim_text: He sees the whole island of Cuba again and says it is very dark, very dark again.
quote: It's very It's very dark. It's very dark again
falsify_match: Further Cuban blackouts.
falsify_miss: The grid stabilises. Island-wide blackouts had already happened repeatedly before this.

claim_text: They are hiding their bases and strategic commanders underneath these facilities, with a girls' school among them and America saying it did not do it, and he prays there will be no cave, rock or place of refuge for the evildoers and that all will be brought to justice.
quote: they're hiding their bases and their strategic commanders underneath these facilities
falsify_match: Command sites confirmed under civilian buildings.
falsify_miss: None confirmed. This is the earliest telling of the human shields claim in the record so far.

claim_text: A shock and awe event in the days ahead that will completely rattle the world because two things happen at one time, with the people of Cuba liberated and the Lord setting them free from a bloodline of terrorism.
quote: there will be two things happen in one at one time
falsify_match: Two major simultaneous events, one of them Cuban.
falsify_miss: A single event, or none. The two-at-once structure is what would have to match.

claim_text: The dictatorship bloodline is eliminated, the Cuban people liberated with a great revival, that man removed, revival brought to Venezuela and Mexico with the Mexican president's days numbered, and some agreement where Cuba becomes almost part of America.
quote: Cuba becomes almost part of America in the days ahead
falsify_match: A formal association agreement between Cuba and America.
falsify_miss: None. Almost part of America is vaguer than the statehood he stops short of saying.

claim_text: A spring of growth comes up out of Havana running in all directions with great fruit, and American cars, Ford, Chrysler and GMC, start to be imported, with new and used F-150 trucks driving on Cuban streets under a darkness still over the country.
quote: I saw F-150 trucks driving around on Cuban streets
falsify_match: New American vehicles sold in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. American vehicle sales to Cuba are barred, and the island's fleet is famously pre-1960.

claim_text: A light springs out of Cuba with an internet cable running over to Europe carrying power, with Russia dealing with them and America dealing with them, and Cuban cigars with a yellow band appearing.
quote: an internet cable that went over into Europe
falsify_match: A new submarine cable from Cuba toward Europe.
falsify_miss: None laid. Cuba's existing cable runs to Venezuela and Jamaica, not Europe.

claim_text: The cigars are on the southern side of Cuba rather than the northern, with men smoking them, banded in gold, uncut at the ends and packaged, and it had to do with trade and something economic.
quote: it was a gold band around this Cuban cigar
falsify_match: A cigar export boom from the south of the island.
falsify_miss: None. Gold banding is standard on Cuban cigars already, which weakens the detail.

claim_text: The Secretary of State is a type of David going into Cuba as a diplomat and establishing it as a nation free of the dictatorship, with Venezuela, Mexico and Colombia liberated from the drug cartels and a major revival in Brazil, though he says he is not saying Colombia's leadership is taken out.
quote: Rubio was a type of a David representing in going into Cuba
falsify_match: The Secretary of State leading a Cuban settlement.
falsify_miss: He does not. He narrows the claim himself by excluding Colombian regime change.

claim_text: A man is removed in the days ahead by Navy SEALs, and the Italian mafia in Florida and the five families rise up in the days ahead and come to be seen as heroes against corruption, specifically against the New York mayor, alongside drug trafficking into New York.
quote: they would become like a hero against corruption
falsify_match: Organised crime figures publicly cast as an anti-corruption force in New York.
falsify_miss: None. It is specific enough to recognise if it happened.

claim_text: Darkness all over the island, and the Lord said it will happen in darkness, that phase two will happen in darkness, and it lay heavily on him, unlike the way it happened with Iran.
quote: Phase two will happen in darkness
falsify_match: A Cuban operation beginning during a blackout.
falsify_miss: None. Cuban blackouts predate the word by years, so the darkness is already there.

claim_text: He told his son to watch the news before the Iran strike and it happened twenty four to forty eight hours later, and he feels the same pulse concerning Cuba, where there is an underground facility with a weapon beneath the ground similar to Hiroshima.
quote: there is an underground facility with a weapon that is underneath the ground
falsify_match: A nuclear or comparable weapon found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. It would be the largest single claim in the Cuban material if it were true.

claim_text: Not the next twenty four hours, but in a twenty four hour period everything changes for the Cuban people, seen as a mile marker of what the church in Cuba has prayed for, with a great door opening, great deliverance, great money and financial stability like they have never seen.
quote: in a 24-hour period everything is going to change
falsify_match: A transformation of Cuban government and finances inside a day.
falsify_miss: A slow change, or none. He removes the near-term deadline in the same sentence, as he does in every telling of this.

claim_text: Banks and resources, hotels and resorts, American companies coming into Cuba to build resorts, a tourist industry flowing with cruise ships making it a cruise destination, and Cuban culture and financial stability seen globally.
quote: AMERICAN companies coming into Cuba building for resorts
falsify_match: American cruise lines and hotel companies operating in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. American cruise calls to Cuba were permitted briefly and barred again in 2019, which is what would have to reverse.

claim_text: Great churches start and liberation spreads through Venezuela, Brazil, Mexico and Colombia down into South America, and when he asked whether America would invade North Korea the Lord said no, he would handle that himself and deal with the North Korean leader like Pharaoh.
quote: He said, No, I'll handle that myself
falsify_match: The North Korean leadership falling without American invasion.
falsify_miss: It holds. Ruling out an invasion narrows the claim, which is unusual for this material.

claim_text: A military base being established in Cuba for America.
quote: I see a a military base being established from in Cuba for America
falsify_match: A new American base in Cuba beyond Guantanamo.
falsify_miss: None established. America has held the naval station at Guantanamo since 1903, which is the weaker version already true.

claim_text: The North Korean leader becomes unhinged with paranoia after what happens with Cuba, and he saw two things happen at once, bang bang, before playing a clip of the president talking to Cuban-American owners about going back.
quote: I saw two things happen at once
falsify_match: Two simultaneous events, with a North Korean reaction following.
falsify_miss: None. The paranoia claim is not observable from outside.

claim_text: The same clip in the overlapping window, with the president telling Cuban-American owners they will not need his approval to fly back and that they will celebrate what is going on in Cuba in a couple of weeks.
quote: we'll be together again soon, I suspect, celebrating what's going on in Cuba
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim, though the couple of weeks in it is the tightest date attached to the Cuban material.

claim_text: He plays the president saying Cuba is ready to fall because it has no income now that Venezuelan oil has stopped, and that a lot of Cuban-Americans will be very happy.
quote: Cuba literally is ready to fall
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the clip is not counted as a word.

claim_text: The president says Cuba is going to fall pretty soon and that they want to make a deal so badly that he will put the Secretary of State on it while he focuses on Iran, and he says they should give God the glory because they saw it before it happened.
quote: we saw it before it happened
falsify_match: The earlier recordings name the Cuban collapse before it was public policy talk.
falsify_miss: They do not. The Cuban economy has been in visible crisis since 2021, which is the base rate.

claim_text: He says he told them they would see it in the news and there it is, that darkness is all over Cuba and cyber attacks are coming, and that he also saw them in America, in Philadelphia and parts of New York, with lights shone from the streets onto mirrored glass buildings in the darkness.
quote: Cyber attacks are coming
falsify_match: A cyber attack blacking out American cities.
falsify_miss: None. The mirrored buildings and street lights recur in every telling of the New York blackout.
